role.roleTitle: Data Pipeline Engineer, Developer Tools Platform

evidence.text: Maintained the build-event ingestion pipelines (Kafka consumers writing to the events warehouse) and their schemas, adding schema versioning so that older event formats kept loading after producer changes.
Maintained the daily aggregate jobs that roll build, test and deployment events into the per-repository tables behind the engineering dashboards.

The daily aggregate's completion time dropped from 3 hours 40 minutes to 1 hour 10 minutes after the incremental rewrite was released, measured over the following thirty days in the pipeline monitoring dashboard against the published baseline of 3 hours 40 minutes.

Coordinated schema and job changes with the dashboard team and the platform team in the weekly data sync; the platform lead approved warehouse changes and the dashboard team confirmed the table contracts.

Wrote the lineage note for the aggregate jobs, listing source topics, the incremental logic, the known limitation that late events beyond 48 hours were not re-aggregated, and the hand-over items for on-call.
evidence.notes: The candidate wrote a lineage note, but it is unclear if this was done for each pipeline release.
